tools.name: grant_bucket_user_access
tools.description: Grants a specified IAM user a role-based access level on an S3 bucket by updating the bucket policy. Adds a policy statement allowing read-only or read-write access to the bucket's objects.

params.name: user_arn
params.description: ARN of the IAM user to grant access to

tools.name: move_objects_by_prefix
tools.description: Moves all objects under a source prefix to a destination prefix within a bucket by copying each one and removing the original. Lists the objects first and returns a summary of the keys moved.
tools.code:
import boto3

s3 = boto3.client("s3")


def move_objects_by_prefix(bucket: str, src_prefix: str, dst_prefix: str) -> dict:
    result = {
        "bucket": bucket,
        "src_prefix": src_prefix,
        "dst_prefix": dst_prefix,
        "moved": [],
        "failed": [],
        "total_bytes": 0,
    }

    if src_prefix == dst_prefix:
        result["error"] = "source and destination are identical"
        return result

    paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=src_prefix):
        for obj in page.get("Contents", []):
            key = obj["Key"]
            new_key = dst_prefix + key[len(src_prefix):]
            try:
                s3.copy_object(
                    Bucket=bucket,
                    Key=new_key,
                    CopySource={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
                )
                s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
                result["moved"].append({"from": key, "to": new_key})
                result["total_bytes"] += obj["Size"]
            except Exception as e:
                result["failed"].append({"key": key, "error": str(e)})

    result["count"] = len(result["moved"])
    return result

tools.name: run_lifecycle_cleanup_job
tools.description: Starts an S3 Batch Operations job that applies tag changes to the objects listed in a manifest, and writes the job ID to a tracking record in a local SQLite database. Runs the job immediately once confirmed.

params.name: role
params.description: ARN of the IAM role the job runs as

params.name: rpt_bkt
params.description: Bucket ARN for the job completion report

tools.name: set_object_public_read_acl
tools.description: Makes a single object in a bucket publicly readable, or reverts it to private, by changing the object's ACL.

params.name: public
params.description: True to make the object public-read, False to make it private
